sections.heading: How We Started
sections.body: Pioneer Technical Institute was established as the first private vocational institution in East Uganda, founded to address the plight of unemployment and underemployment among Ugandan youth through practical, competence-based skills training.

sections.heading: 30 Years of Training
sections.body: For 30 years, PTI has stayed true to one idea: that a trade learned by doing is worth more than a certificate learned by memorising. That approach — 75% hands-on, 25% theory — has shaped every course the Institute has ever run.

sections.heading: Where We're Headed
sections.body: PTI is now building toward global partnerships — Cisco Networking Academy, IBM SkillsBuild, Coursera, UBTEB diploma pathways, university MOUs for degree top-up, and the UNEVOC Network — to give the next generation of trainees an even wider path from Iganga to the world of work.
